newsitem.title: UK: Ldn Freight - Panamaxes busy in the Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Ldn Freight - Panamaxes busy in the Atlantic.

text.p: News reached the dry cargo market on Thursday of more firmer fixtures agreed by charterers ahead of the Christmas holidays.

Panamax grain activity in the Atlantic continued at a busy level with some rates to the East showing significant increases. There were also reports of higher fertilizer rates in the US Gulf/China trade. Caper levels rained very steady without showing the same appreciation enjoyed by Panamaxes. Geared bulkcarrier business was said to be quiet from the Continent but more active in the Western Atlantic, and the rates in the Far East were reported to be a little firmer in some cases.

A jump in the January rate in the US Gulf/Japan trade was rumoured, brokers said. Following reports that the 1981-built Maricobber was fixed for 52,000/s heavy grain for Jan 5/15 at $25.00 no combo, it was understood that $26.00 no combo had been conceded by S Korean charterers for similar dates. Timecharter levels also moved up in parallel with Glory Cape 68,000 dwt fixed delivery Morocco end Dec trip via US Gulf to the Far East at $14,500 daily. Merchant Pride 69,458 dwt was reported fixed by HMM delivery US Gulf first half Jan trip Far East at $15,000 daily plus $300,000 bonus, and rumours circulated that Thetis 73,000 dwt had agreed about $15,250 daily delivery Ghent early Jan on this route (denied by some brokers).

A 1993-built 65,500 dwt vessel was said to have been offered $15,500 daily delivery prompt Greece for a trip via US Gulf to the Far East. Cargill fixed an OBO for about 60,000 heavy grain US Gulf/N Continent for mid Dec at $13.65 basis 49' (up 55 cents from the rate agreed for Patmos a week ago) and also a vessel of about 40,000 tonnes cargo capacity for similar business at a weak $13.25. These charterers are still in the market for Dec for US Gulf/Continent. Caper tonnage was speculatively linked with grain business - Kleon 90,966 dwt delivery US Gulf Dec trip Arabian Gulf with Geepee at about $11,000 daily plus $250,000 bonus, and Europa 110,342 dwt delivery Passero for a Plate round with Romac with grain to Egypt redelivery Passe at about $11,000 daily.

In the East Continental booked the 1981-built Pateras 65,535 dwt delivery NoPac Dec 16/21 trip Japan at $11,500 daily plus unspecified bonus and there were rumours these charterers may have covered a similar stem on voyage basis at about $15.25 combo for slightly later dates. Pan Ocean may have fixed Yu Long Shan 64,446 dwt for Australian grain to Bin Qasim but details were lacking. Fresh grain requirements were quoted by Dreyfus with 50,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Kosicng for Dec 27/Jan 10 and 21-31,000 grains 55' US Gulf/Cadiz-La Coruna range for Dec 20/30. Cereol have 48-52,000 heavy grain Mississippi/Spanish Med for Jan 3/10, and Andre 25,000 wheat Plate/Algeria for Dec 18/Jan 6. Andre were rumoured to have fallen apart with Yannis K for about 20,000/10 wheat Plate/Port Sudan at about $38.00 against $39.00.

Details of a number of Caper fixtures remained private - Omiros 220,000 dwt for ironore for Jan from Tubarao to Rotterdam and Antwerp with Kleimar, for example, and Mount Athos for 150,000/10 from Tubarao to India for Dec/Jan with Cobelfret. Urgup was understood fixed by Chinese charterers for 130,000 ironore Saldanha Bay/Beilun for Jan 15/30 at close to $7.65, and Cherokee 162,800 dwt was rumoured fixed by Docenave for 2 laden legs into the Atlantic via Roberts Bank.

Panamaxes continued in strong demand from S Africa with reports indicating that a 1978-built 80,000 dwt was bid $8,500 daily delivery prompt passing an trip via S Africa redelivery Skaw-Passero. But the fixture of the day was the NSAC-relet Alfios to Atlantic fertilizers for 50,000/10 dap for mid Dec from Pascagoula to China at $31.00, up $7.50 from the last fixture reported concluded by these charterers at the beginning of last week.
